2020 Q4.bq: Despite the 777 production interruption, our Manitoba operations exceeded the top end of our 2020 copper production guidance range and refined zinc metal production was higher than it has been in over 10 years.

2021 Q1.gq: Our full year 2021 production and operation cost guidance has been reaffirmed and we are pleased to announce Pampacancha commenced production at the end of April, in line with the timelines incorporated into our guidance and recent updated mine plan.

2021 Q2.gq: Our full-year 2021 key production and operating cost guidance has been reaffirmed.

2021 Q3.bq: As noted last quarter, molybdenum production is a smaller part of our business, and we expect it to fall slightly below the 2021 guidance range, but in line with the recently published mine plan for Constancia.

2025 Q4.bq: In Peru, we exceeded the top end of the annual gold production guidance range and achieved the copper production guidance range despite the impact of a temporary operational interruption due to social unrest.
